company.name: Mainspring Energy
company.shortDescription: Mainspring Energy provides power generation technology using linear generators for clean energy.
company.description: Mainspring Energy develops and manufactures linear generators that convert fuel into electricity. The company focuses on providing clean energy solutions that enhance power generation efficiency. Its technology is designed to support various applications, including onsite power generation. Mainspring Energy emphasizes sustainability and aims to contribute to the transition to cleaner energy sources. Through its innovative approach, the company seeks to meet the growing demand for flexible and environmentally friendly energy solutions. Partnerships with other organizations further expand its capabilities in delivering effective energy systems.

aiResearchSummary.text: Mainspring Energy is researching linear generator systems, as described in titles such as 'A linear generator system' and 'Integrated linear generator system,' focusing on integrating generator assemblies, control, exhaust, intake, and cooling systems. Efforts include controlling piston trajectory, energy storage and conversion, and synchronization of multiple linear generators. Additional work addresses ammonia fuel use, high-power core systems, and advanced sealing and bearing assemblies for efficient power generation.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series F round raised $258,000,000, or 31.73% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 2 disclosed grants total $87,000,000, representing 10.7% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $24,508,580 to $1,933,633,282, a 78.9x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 66 (-8 over 90 days) and market heat at 64 (-11).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
